articles.title: Ameren seeks electric rate increase
articles.description: COLUMBIA, Mo. (KMIZ) Ameren Missouri is seeking to raise electric rates, according to a Wednesday press release from the Public Service Commission. Ameren filed tariff sheets with the PSC on June 26 “seeking a net increase in annual electric base rate revenues of approximately $343 million,” or about $13 per month for the average customer,

articles.title: Oppd crews aid Illinois storm power restoration
articles.description: Omaha Public Power District is sending 16 mutual aid crew members to assist Ameren’s power restoration in Illinois after a damaging windstorm cut electricity.
articles.content:
Omaha Public Power District is sending mutual aid crews to Danville, Ill., to support restoration efforts after a fast-moving storm took out power for 220,000 customers.
